GAB.note: Training is for young people, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The national digital infrastructure agency ANINF, with Cybastion, launched the first free certified digital-skills and cybersecurity cohort of 150 young Gabonese in Libreville on 13 April 2026, within a commitment to train 1,000 under DigiEmpower.

GAB.note: Training programme only; no government-run system is stated.
